description: WRITE. Opens a UCP lodging booking session from a quoted offer (stay_id from get_availability_quote). Returns the authoritative total, the cancellation policy (show it to the traveler), the Virtuoso amenities, the payment term (pay at the hotel) and evidence. Nothing is charged; the session is held until the quote expires.

booker.description: Lead traveler (legal name + email). Without it the session stays "incomplete".

name: create_booking_session
title: Start a booking (UCP lodging)
